SELECT we.execution_id AS trace_id, 'workflow' AS span_type, w.workflow_name AS name, we.status, we.duration_ms, we.started_at, we.finished_at, we.error_message FROM workflow_execution we INNER JOIN workflow w ON we.workflow_id = w.id AND w.is_deleted = 0 WHERE we.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND we.started_at >= #{since} AND we.status = #{status}
AND (we.execution_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR w.workflow_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT we.execution_id AS trace_id, 'workflow' AS span_type, w.workflow_name AS name, we.status, we.duration_ms, we.started_at, we.finished_at, we.error_message FROM workflow_execution we INNER JOIN workflow w ON we.workflow_id = w.id AND w.is_deleted = 0 WHERE we.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND we.execution_id = #{traceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(tu.trace_id, ''), CONCAT('agent-', tu.id)) AS trace_id, 'agent' AS span_type, COALESCE(a.agent_name, '未知 Agent') AS name, CASE WHEN tu.success IS NULL OR tu.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS status, tu.latency_ms AS duration_ms, tu.created_at AS started_at, tu.created_at AS finished_at, tu.error_message FROM token_usage tu LEFT JOIN agent a ON tu.agent_id = a.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.id = #{usageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(tu.trace_id, ''), CONCAT('agent-', tu.id)) AS trace_id, 'agent' AS span_type, COALESCE(a.agent_name, '未知 Agent') AS name, CASE WHEN tu.success IS NULL OR tu.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS status, tu.latency_ms AS duration_ms, tu.created_at AS started_at, tu.created_at AS finished_at, tu.error_message FROM token_usage tu LEFT JOIN agent a ON tu.agent_id = a.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY tu.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT wnl.node_id, COALESCE(wn.node_name, wnl.node_id) AS node_name, wnl.node_type, wnl.status, wnl.duration_ms, wnl.error_message, wnl.started_at, wnl.finished_at FROM workflow_node_log wnl LEFT JOIN workflow_execution we ON wnl.execution_id = we.execution_id LEFT JOIN workflow_node wn ON wn.workflow_id = we.workflow_id AND wn.node_id = wnl.node_id WHERE wnl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND wnl.execution_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY wnl.started_at, wnl.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND usage_date = CURDATE() AND success = 0

SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(HOUR(MIN(created_at)), 2, '0'), ':00') AS time_label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND success = 0 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY HOUR(created_at) ORDER BY HOUR(created_at)

SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(HOUR(MIN(created_at)), 2, '0'), ':00') AS time_label, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS value FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY HOUR(created_at) ORDER BY HOUR(created_at)
